title: bumelia celastrina var. angustifolia
intro: Bumelia celastrina var. angustifolia, commonly known as the Narrowleaf Bumelia, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This shrub or small tree is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Bumelia celastrina var. angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been attributed to its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties.
